notes.text: Desktop web is usable after scanning with the Jike mobile app. The home feed includes a built-in composer with a contenteditable textbox, circle selector, send button, and a native input[type=file] for image uploads.
For build-in-public revenue updates, a softer Chinese progress-log tone works better than a promotional product announcement. Verified circle choice: iOS开发者小站.
[success verification] Verified the new Jike post appears at the top of the feed under [username], includes the published text snippet, one image preview, and the iOS开发者小站 circle tag.

workflows.name: Publish a Jike progress update with one image
workflows.description: Post a lightweight revenue or progress update on Jike web after app-scan login.
steps: Open web.okjike.com and scan login with the Jike app if needed.
Use the built-in home composer and select a relevant circle such as iOS开发者小站.
Fill the contenteditable textbox with a soft, first-person progress update.
Upload one collage image through input[type=file].
Click 发送 and verify the new post appears at the top of the feed with the image and circle tag.
